title: Calendar event
description: One event, one file (calendar/events/<uid>.json), in the shape of a JSCalendar Event (RFC 8984): a start in local time with its IANA time zone and a duration. Events derived from dated records (open decisions with a due time, releases) are never stored; packages/naive/src/engine/calendar.mjs computes them each time the calendar is read.

uid.description: Globally unique; the file's name without .json

start.description: A JSCalendar LocalDateTime: the wall-clock time in timeZone, with no offset

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, for example America/New_York

duration.description: An RFC 8984 Duration, for example PT1H

recurrenceRules.description: Optional RFC 8984 recurrence rules; stored, not yet expanded by the list view

calendar.description: The calendar it belongs to, by id (calendar/calendars/<id>.json)
